baseline_source: ez-wo15b-skyrme-baseline-v1: the starting vector is HFBTHO's own nuclear-matter block for SKM*, printed by the solver when run with the WO-15 REFIT_STRICT pairing, not a value recomputed from the (t,x) parameters by this repository. Equivalence between the named-functional binary and the READ_FUNCTIONAL binary fed this vector is checked before any refit is allowed to run
build_flags: COMPILER=GFORTRAN FORTRAN_MPI=gfortran AD=0 GOGNY=1 GOGNY_SYMMETRIES=1 GOGNY_HYPER=1 USE_OPENMP=1 READ_FUNCTIONAL=1 -O3
build_notes: serial make: the shipped dependency graph races under -j; hfbtho_gogny.o is pre-compiled and linked explicitly because the sub-Makefile's ifeq ($GOGNY,1) guard is missing parentheses and never fires; HDF5 fortran modules and libs are pointed at the distribution's serial paths
patch_diff:
--- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/7b0fa312-9387-52a9-88e7-fb2ada207813/scratchpad/read_functional.orig.f90	2026-08-17 02:32:11.847248951 +0000
+++ data/physics_backends/hfbtho/src/hfbtho_ad/hfbtho_read_functional.f90	2026-08-17 02:32:21.838580604 +0000
@@ -84,18 +84,22 @@
 
   subroutine read_HFBTHO_Functional
     implicit none
-    integer(ipr) :: lfunctional=16,i
+    integer(ipr) :: lfunctional=16,i,n_items_found
     character(len=500) :: line
     open(lfunctional,file='hfbtho_FUNCTIONAL.dat')
     read(lfunctional,*)
     read(lfunctional,'(a)') line
     close(lfunctional)
-    n_func_param =  n_items(line)
-    if(n_func_param.lt.12.or.n_func_param.gt.15) then
-       stop 'The number of parameters in hfbtho_FUNCTIONAL.dat has to be between 12 and 15'
+!   ElementZero WO-15B compatibility patch. Upstream reads a variable
+!   count into an allocatable functional_vector, but hfbtho_variables
+!   declares n_func_param as a Parameter (12) and functional_vector as a
+!   fixed Dimension(1:n_func_param) array, so the original body does not
+!   compile against its own module. The count is validated against the
+!   declared size instead of being assigned; nothing else changes.
+    n_items_found = n_items(line)
+    if(n_items_found.ne.n_func_param) then
+       stop 'hfbtho_FUNCTIONAL.dat must hold exactly n_func_param values'
     endif
-    if(allocated(functional_vector)) deallocate(functional_vector)
-    allocate(functional_vector(1:n_func_param))
     read(line,*) functional_vector(1:n_func_param)
   end subroutine read_HFBTHO_Functional
purpose: Enable a mass-oriented Skyrme refit by building HFBTHO with READ_FUNCTIONAL=1, and prove the alternate path reproduces the named functional before any parameter is moved
upstream_patch: ez-wo15b-hfbtho-readfunc-patch-v1: hfbtho_read_functional.f90 as distributed reads a variable parameter count into an allocatable functional_vector, but hfbtho_variables declares n_func_param as a Parameter (12) and functional_vector as a fixed-size array, so the subroutine does not compile against its own module. The patch replaces the assignment-and-allocate with a count check against the declared size. No physics path is touched, and the equivalence check is what demonstrates that
